sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Shameem Akther
 And
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice N. Tukaramji
 Writ Petition No.22150 Of 2020

(Per Hon'ble Dr.SA,J) This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, wherein, the following prayer is made:
"... to issue a Writ of Habeas Corpus or any other appropriate Writ, Order or Orders,
Direction or Directions to declare the proceedings of the 2nd respondent in C.No.
36/PDCe11/CCRB/RGM/2020, dated 17.11.2020 whereby the husband of the petitioner Markawar Ramesh Bhaskar @ Marka Ramesh, S/o. Bhaskar Markawar,
R/o. Chickpipari Village, Vittalwadi Post, Gondipipari Tahsil, Chandrapur District,
Maharashtra, has been subjected to preventive detention by invoking Sec.3(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticides Offenders, Fertilizers Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Schedule Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders,
Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders & White Collar or Financial Offenders Act,
1986 (as amended in Act No.13 of 2018), as illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional and to set aside the same and direct release of Markawar Ramesh Bhaskar @ Marka Ramesh, S/o. Bhaskar Markawar, R/o. Chickpipari Village, Vittalwadi Post,
Gondipipari Tahsil, Chandrapur District, Maharashtra and pass such other order or orders ..."

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the impugned detention order was passed against the detenu on 17.11.2020 and the period of detention has been completed and therefore,
nothing survives for adjudication in this Writ Petition.
4. Recording the said submission, the Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
